configuration.title: Recent Copilot Chat ID
configuration.enabled.description: Enable read-only filename scanning of local Copilot Chat session storage on this machine. This setting is not synced, and chat content is never read.
configuration.readTitles.description: Read session titles and bounded timing, response-state, and changed-line metadata from VS Code's local chat index. Titles can be derived from chat content. Chat messages are never read, metadata remains in memory only, and this setting is not synced.
configuration.readUsage.description: On demand, read the selected local Copilot Chat JSON/JSONL session file to show backend-reported AI Credits and model token totals. Session files contain chat content, but only the usage summary is retained in memory. No data is sent over the network, and this setting is not synced. Disabling it clears cached usage and closes the open Session Inspector.
